name: ArduinoJson
author: Benoit Blanchon
sentence: An efficient and elegant JSON library for Arduino and IoT.
paragraph: ArduinoJson is a C++ JSON library for Arduino and other microcontrollers. Supports JSON parsing, serialization, and MessagePack.

name: Adafruit NeoPixel
author: Adafruit
sentence: Arduino library for controlling single-wire-based LED pixels and strip.
paragraph: Fast, hardware-optimized library for WS2811, WS2812, WS2812B, WS2813 and SK6812 RGB / RGBW LED pixels.

name: PubSubClient
author: Nick O'Leary
sentence: A client library for MQTT messaging on Arduino.
paragraph: Provides simple publish/subscribe messaging with a server that supports MQTT.

name: WiFiManager
author: tzapu
sentence: ESP8266 & ESP32 WiFi Connection manager with captive portal.
paragraph: ESP8266 and ESP32 WiFi connection manager with captive portal for SSID/password entry without hardcoding secrets.

name: FastLED
author: Daniel Garcia
sentence: Multi-platform library for controlling addressable LEDs.
paragraph: High-performance LED animation library supporting WS2812, APA102, LPD8806, and dozens of other addressable LED controllers.

name: Adafruit GFX Library
author: Adafruit
sentence: Adafruit GFX graphics core library for displays.
paragraph: Core graphics library providing primitives (points, lines, circles, fonts) for OLED, TFT, and e-paper displays.

name: DHT sensor library
author: Adafruit
sentence: Arduino library for DHT11, DHT22, etc Temp & Humidity Sensors.
paragraph: Unified sensor driver for DHT series digital relative humidity and temperature sensors.

name: TFT_eSPI
author: Bodmer
sentence: Blazing fast SPI library for ESP8266 and ESP32 displays.
paragraph: High-speed graphics library for SPI displays including ST7789, ILI9341, ILI9488, GC9A01 with DMA acceleration.

name: ESPAsyncWebServer
author: lacamera
sentence: Asynchronous HTTP and WebSocket server for ESP8266 & ESP32.
paragraph: Asynchronous web server designed for high concurrency and REST APIs on ESP microcontrollers.

name: Servo
author: Michael Margolis
sentence: Allows Arduino boards to control RC servo motors.
paragraph: Controls RC servo motors using hardware timers on standard Arduino boards.

name: LiquidCrystal I2C
author: Frank de Brabander
sentence: Drive HD44780 LCD displays via PCF8574 I2C adapter.
paragraph: Control character LCDs using only two I2C pins instead of 6 to 10 digital IO pins.

name: Bounce2
author: Thomas O Fredericks
sentence: Debouncing library for Arduino and Wiring.
paragraph: Debounce noisy mechanical switches and buttons with edge detection and interval filters.
